tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyes mchog rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' drin rjes su dran phyir dang / /lo rgyus khungs su btsun pa'i phyir/ /skyes mchog rin chen bzang po yi/ /lo rgyus mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /de la lo tsā ba byang chub sems dpa'i gdung brgyud gang yin pa/ sku gang du 'khrungs pa/ rab tu gang du byung ba/ lo tsā ji ltar bslabs shing chos ji ltar bsgyur ba dang / gnas gzhi dang gtsug lag khang ji ltar bzhengs tshul/ dgongs sgrub khyad par can gar mdzad pa/ gnas gang nas mkha' spyod du gshegs pa dang bdun no/ /dang po gdung rus/ lha nyi ma hrugs kyi gdung brgyud yin pas/ hrugs hor zhes kyang zer ro/ /zhang po klu dang 'brel bas klu zor zhes kyang bya'o/ /kha che zhes bya ba ni yul gyi ming ngo / /yab ni ban chen po gzhon nu dbang phyug yum cog ro za kun bzang shes rab bstan no/ /de la sras lcam sring bzhi las/ shes rab dbang phyug rin chen dbang phyug yon tan dbang phyug go /lcam mo kun sring shes rab mtsho mo'o/ /lo tsā ba'i mtshan ni rin chen dbang phyug go /gcen khyim pa'i cha bzung / gcung rab tu byung nas thugs las chung ngu la bzhugs/ lcam mo ni dge slong (slob )mar byas nas/ sngags kyi chos bslabs nas bsgrubs pas grub pa brnyes pa'i/ rnal 'byor ma chos kyi sgron ma'o/ /lo tsā ba yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ yum gyi snang ba la/ nyin mtshan rtag tu spyi gtsug na gser gyi bye'u chung g.yu'i mche sder can/ snyan pa'i sgra sna tshogs sgrogs cing phur phur lhab lhab byed cing gnas pa'i snang ba shar ro/ /de nas btsa' ba'i dus la babs tsa na/ gser gyi bye'u chung yum gyi spyi gtsug tu thim nas/ gsang gnas nas gser gyi bya khyung g.yu'i mche sder can gcig byung nas/ yum la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/

dgung 'phangs gcod kyin 'gro ba rmis ste/ de nas khye'u sha mdog ser ba/ bya gdong du yod pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil na 'khor lo'i ri mo yod pa zhig rta lo dbyar zla tha chung gi tshes bcu'i nyin mo sku bltams so/ /dgung lo gnyis lon mar bcad zhal nas/ a ā i ī zhes gsung gin sa la ri mo 'bri yin thal mo sbyar nas bzhad pa gcig byung bas/ yab kyis las 'phro can cig yin nam dgongs nas/ gos ser mo bskon nas dge bsnyen tsam du mdzad do/ /gnyis pa 'khrungs yul ni/ mes g.yu sgra stong btsan gyis mchod pa'i yul skyo bang du 'khrungs so/ /gsum pa rab tu byung ba ni/ mkhan po legs pa bzang po las dgung lo bcu gsum pa la mdzad do/ /zla ba gcig la sum brgya pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa thugs su chud do/ /bzhi pa lo tsā ji ltar bslab pa ni/ dgung lo bcu bdun lon tsa na/ o rgyan yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta gcig byon nas/ yum las gdan chung blangs nas bza' ba drangs pa'i shul du paṇ+ḍi ta'i rgya dpe be'u bum legs mo gcig lus pa la gzigs pas/ 'di'i nang na gdam ngag khyad par can 'dra bzhugs nas 'ong ste rgya yig mi shes dgongs nas/ shing gi grib ma gcig la gzims nas bzhugs pa dang / mnal du song ba'i rnal lam du/ bud med sha rtsi dmar ba rin po che'i cod paṇa dang / dar dpyangs sham bu do shal rnams kyis brgyan pa/ lag pa g.yon pa me tog spar gang thogs pa/ g.yon pa ḍā ma ru khrol ba gcig dbu sngas su 'ongs nas 'di skad zer ro/ /srin bu'i kha chus rang lus bcings pa ltar/ /yul la zhen pa bdud kyi rgya ru tshud/ /bde 'gro thar pa 'dod pa'i mi su dag /lho nub kha che'i yul du phyin na bde/ /zhes zer ba thos te/ mnal sad pa dang lus rngul nas chur zhugs pa bzhin song / thugs kyang shin tu 'phyos/ slar khyim du gshegs so/ /de nas lo tsā ba'i thugs dgongs la/ bdag la mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan nas/

kha cher ma phyin na/ srog dang chos kyi bar chad du 'gro bar 'dug 'gro na sa rgyus kyang med la/ pha ma gnyis kyi sems kyang dkrugs na/ bdag la bag chags ngan pa 'gos par 'dug pas/ ji ltar bya snyam nas thugs 'khor zhing bzhugs pa las/ yum gyis sras kyi gdong pa la bltas pas sngar bas shin tu nag par gzigs nas/ bu na'am/ sdug bsngal ci byung dris pas/ sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhib tu smras so/ /de nas yab yum dang mched zla rnams kyis gros byas te/ bu 'di ma btang na bar chad du 'gyur nyen 'dug pas/ btang dgos zhes gros byas nas khong kha che'i yul du gshegs par byas so/ /de nas khong pa'i a po dge bsnyen rtse mo bya ba gcig la rogs bcol nas/ phag lo dgung lo bco brgyad lon tsa na g.yul thon pa dang / 'gron bu drug brgya tsam dang / yum gyis zhim la gshin pa'i gsol zas mang du bskur/ na bza' bag rul du byas te chas pa las/ mgul cham drag po gcig gis zhag 'ga' chag des dus lha bla ma'i thugs lam du/ spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs kar srin lag gis reg mdzad nas/ bu gcig smon lam dag pas kha ba'i ljongs su 'khrungs/ lung bstan pa yi gzhi 'dzin bya yi gdong pa can/ lho nub kha che'i yul du 'gro ba la/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad don can snying po long / gsungs pa'i rjes la mi snang bar song ngo / /lung bstan byung ba la dri ba bya dgos snyam nas dris pas/ ban chen po'i sras bar pa kha cher bzhud pa la/ mgul cham byung nas zhag 'ga' chag zhus pas/ nga la lung bstan yod pas shog gyis/ ban nga rang gi blon po yin pa la nga la ma zhus par bu gtong ba mi 'thad gsung nas/ mang 'khor ba dge ldan spyan 'dren du btang bas byon/ gser srang bcu gnyis lnga la btums nas brdzangs/ lam rim pa bzhi pa yang gsungs/ tshar gcig la mkhyen/ lha bla ma'i zhal nas/ bstan pa la phan nas mchi/ spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rjes bzung nas/ 'u mkha' spyod du mjal mchi gsung /

rong chung pa blo bde dang / kyi nor ba grub pa gnyis rogs la brdzangs/ kho pa shi yis dogs nas phyi phyag byas nas ma byon/ der mas nyug ti'i mon 'khyams pa/ sa rgyus shes pa gcig dang 'grogs nas/ gar zha la bshul thon nas/ ldom bu mdzad kyin gshegs so/ /de nas zla gcig zhag gsum gyi ngo la ke ri ka bya ba'i yul du sleb pa dang / rogs po nyug ti ba rgyu 'grul 'tsher nas phyi phyag byas ma byung ngo / /khong pa dpon g.yog gis khyi lpags 'dom la dkris nas/ de nas zhag gsum gyi lam du bskyod pa dang / ma hā sang ga la bya ba'i zam pa chen po gcig tu/ sho gam 'don pa'i 'phrang bsrungs pa'i grong gsum yod pa las/ 'gron bu lnga bcu tsam byin nas/ nub gcig zhe 'tsher re ba la der gzims so/ /nang par nam langs pa dang / zam pa brgal nas bskyod pas/ zam pa'i sum gnyis tsam thon tsa na/ rogs po nad drag pos zin nas shi la thug pa dang / khong rang yang sku lus shin tu ngal bar rnal du song ngo / /skabs der/ shi sgyid kyi chom rkun gsum zhig rgyu 'grul byed pa dang 'dzom du nye ba las/ thugs lam du/ sngar gyi yul du lung bstan pa'i mkha' 'gro ma de 'ongs nas/ bu longs shig nad pa la ni mdangs kyi zam 'phrang na chos la mi dga' ba'i gnod sbyin mo gcig yod pa des bar chad byed par rtsom pa yin/ de bdag gis bzlog nas nad myur po sos pa 'dug ste/ shi sgyid kyi jag pa byung ngo / /lam gol sar 'dug la bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba thob cig ces zer ba'i sgra thos te/ skrag gin bzhengs nas nad pa lag nas khrid de/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs kyin gom pa bzhi bcu tsam spos nas/ slar gzigs pa dang / da ci'i bzhugs sa ru shi sgyid kyi jag pa rnams mtshon cha rnams bton nas sleb so/ /dkon mchog gi sku skyabs dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i byin rlabs kyis khong ma mthong bar lam drang po la zhugs nas song ngo /

/de nas dar gcig bzhugs pa dang nad pa yang sos so/ /jag pa'i 'jigs pa dang bral nas dbugs phyung nas dga' zhing spro ba'i sems kyis/ la thon po de rgal nas gshegs pa dang / za la gsol du gsol chas ci yang mi mnga' ste/ nags gseb kyi bshul kha gcig na yar gshegs pa dang / rgan mo ma smad gnyis 'bras khur re khur nas 'ong ba dang 'phrad pa de la phyag bzed bas/ 'bras spar mo bzhi bzhi phul nas/ 'bras chan bkol nas gsol bas gya nom par gyur to/ /de nas sbyin lan gsung gin thugs dgongs la/ rgan mo ma smad 'di gnyis ni ma dang srin mo'i dod du byung bas/ drin lan du/ rgan mo la sang shid gcig drin lan gcig btab dgos dgongs nas/ rgan mo la khyod kyi skra'i rtse mo nas dum gcig blang ces phyag brda mdzad pas/ rgan mo shin tu sems dkar ba gcig yod pas/ dgos na skra rangs pa chod cig ces lag brda byed/ der khong gis ba so'i thugs rje chen po mtshon gang pa tsam mnga' ba bton nas/ tse tri'i dpe mdzad/ 'dir bsre ba'i ched yin zhes phyag brda mdzad pas/ rgan mo rjes su yi rang nas/ skra'i rtse nas dum gcig bcad nas phul te/ phyag 'tshal nas/ lce la lag pa nyug gin 'di chad nas med zer zhing mchi ma bton nas song ngo / /de ru khong yang thugs rje skyes nas mchi ma gcig shor gsungs/ phyis kha che ru rgan mo'i don du/ ri ti'i mchod rten bzhengs nas/ tse tri mang du btab so/ /de nas nyi ma phyed tsam du bskyod pa dang kha che'i yul sna zin te/ bram ze grong bdun pa cig tu sleb nas de ru zla ba gcig tu bzhugs nas 'phral skad en tshod gcig bslabs so/ /de nas zhag gi shul du bskyod pa dang / shing drung gcig na dzo ki gcer bu ba gcig mi rkang gi gling bu 'bud pa gcig dang mjal nas/ dzo kis lo tsā ba'i mgo la gling bu lan gsum rgyab nas nags gseb tu gar gshegs cha med do/ /phyis grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa rat+na sid+dhi te grub thob rin chen dngos grub ces bya ba de dus byin brlabs la byon pa yin 'dug ste zhal ma mtshon pas 'gyod pa drag po skyes gsungs/

de nas cung zad yar gshegs pa dang / stag grus ma gcig dang phrad pa la/ nags gseb nas mi rkang gi gling bu gcig sing zhes pa'i sgra zhig grags pas/ stag grus ma logs la bzur nas song ste/ da ci'i dzo ki'i byin brlabs yin par shes nas mos gus drag po skyes gsung / de nas cung zad gcig phar gshegs pa dang / tshong pa mang po dang mjal nas bsod snyoms mdzad pas 'bras mang po 'bul du byung ngo / /de nas nub gcig tshong pa de kun gyi rtsa ru gzims nas/ phyis de zhag rgyus legs mo dris nas/ nyi ma dros kyi bar du byon pas/ kā la tsakri ces bya ba'i grong du slebs so/ /thog mar kha che'i byis pa rnams 'ongs nas/ 'di lta bu'i sma ra med la lus po ser po'i mi gcig ltos zer gyin ga zha mang po byed du byung ngo / /de nas khyim bdag rgan po gcig la gnas sa g.yar nas zhag 'ga' bzhugs te/ zhag gcig grong gi dbus su bsod snyoms la byon pas/ bram ze rgan po gcig dang mjal nas lag bris gzigs pas/ bram ze cang mi smra bar khyim du logs song ngo / /dar gcig tsa na dngul gyi phor ba gcig me tog gis bkang nas khong la phul te phyag 'tshal du byung ba dang / khong gis ma bsnams pas thu ba nas 'jus kyin phul te/ khyed tshe rabs nas tshe rabs su tshogs bsags pa'i las can gcig 'dug pas/ tshe 'di la'ang chos mang du shes shing / sems can la phan mang du thogs par 'dug gis/ bdag gis phul ba'i me tog dang phor bu 'di khyod kyis long cig zer bas khong gis phyag tu blangs nas/ bod kyi skad du/ yon bsngo ba mdzad pas/ mi gzhan kun gyi sngar bod skad ma thos pas/ bzhad gad dang gad mo ru byed/ bram ze ni rjes su yi rangs nas khyim du song ngo / /de nas kā la tsakra'i grong de nas cung zad shar ngos su gshegs pa dang / grong khyer ka li bya ba'i dbus/ lo ka kirti mahā bi ha ra bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du byon pas/

paṇ+ḍi ta gu ṇa mi tra zhes bya ba rig pa'i gnas lnga la ma rmongs par khyad par can zhig paṇa chung lnga brgya tsam tsam la chos ston cing bzhugs pa dang mjal nas/ sngar bram zes phul ba'i dngul gyi phor bu de me tog gis bkang te phyag rten byas nas/ phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab ste zla ba bcu bdun du lo tsā bslabs/ sgra tshad byang mor gyur to/ /kha che'i mkhan po dharmā shān+ti las bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /sngar gyi de nas gser srang gcig la 'bul ba byas/ srang phyed la rjes kyi 'bul snod dang cha rkyen mdzad/ de nas mkhas chen pa spru'i so na ra ga dzi'i do sa ya/ a lu'i sang kha ba/ sho ra'i sang kha ba/ sho ra'i mi thi ba/ na dzu'i a pa ra/ la ka'i sangs ka ra/ de rnams la gser srang drug phul nas chos mang du nyan no/ /de nas chos ji ltar bsgyur ba ni/ grong de nas shar phyogs su nyi ma drug gi lam na grong khyer ta ma la sin+ta ta bya ba na/ shin tu snyan pa che ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la ma rmongs pa gcig bzhugs pa gsan nas sngar gyi bla ma rnams la phyi phyag 'tshal ba mdzad de/ gshegs pa'i shul kha nas bya rgod lding ba'i grib ma ltar mgyogs pa'i dzo ki gcig dang mjal nas/ rkang mgyogs kyi rten 'brel mnga' bar rig ste/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas bdag thag ring po'i mi rgyus med 'grul mi nus/ zang zing gi 'bul ba 'bul du sprang po'i shul rgyags la zad cing / cang ma mchis pas/ thugs rje chen pos dgongs la bdag la rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ khyod thag ring gi mi la gdam ngag gnang ste rkang mgyogs mkha' 'gro ma'i chos yin pas/ byin brlabs dang tshogs mchod med par mi gnang gsung pas/ dzo ki'i phyag phyir 'brengs nas/ grong khyer bin dhi ri bya ba ru tshogs mchod kyi cha rkyen blangs nas cha rkyen tshang ba khugs nas zhus pas/ da gnang gi gsungs nas byin rlabs dang tshogs mchod mdzad do/

/ras bubs gcig gis lo tsā ba'i mgul nas btags te/ lus ngag yid gsum bla ma la phul nas rkang mgyogs yid bzhin bsam 'phel zhes bya ba gzigs nas/ drin lan la sngar chos slob pa la bskur ba'i nor lhag bla ma'i gsung dang 'gal bsam nas ma phul ba la/ rmi lam gyi snang ba la/ chos sgrub gegs sel paṇa chen la/ /ku la'ang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ /ces spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi go cha'i lung thob nas/ srang gcig mkha' 'gro mas byin pa yin byas nas phul lo/ /de nas grong khyer ta ma la sin+ta ru gshegs te/ shrar+dha ka ra warmā dang mjal nas/ phyag na rdo rje bsgrub pa'i lung bstan nas/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ri la rgya rim gsum btab nas yod pa/ nga ston pa'i rdo rje mkhyid gang pa dang / ma hā shang ka'i phreng ba brgyad rtsa gcig gnang / sngags kyi bdag po gyis gsungs so/ /gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod 'byung gsungs so/ /yang sprul pa'i yid kyi chos gsung bar gsol ba btab pas gnang nas/ lo gnyis su rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag du ma gsan no/ /gser lhag ma rnams ma lus par phul lo/ /de nas yul du spyod par 'dod pas/ thugs lam na/ bod kyi mi gcig gis rgya mtsho'i gling nas/ nor bu rin po che mang du khug ste/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che gcig lus su 'jug par 'dug de rje btsun chen po na ro pa'i phyag na mnga' ba yin/ ces thugs lam du byung nas/ rnal sad pa dang / bla ma shrād+dha ka ra la lo rgyus de zhus pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas de ltar yin na/ rje btsun chen po'i drung du 'gro dgos so/ /khong gi tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub gdam ngag mang du mkhyen pa yin gsung nas/ bla ma thugs rje dang ldan pas zho gsum gnang nas/ bka' bzhin thugs lam bzung nas/ byang phyogs su mahā ri'i dpal me tog brgyan pa'i grong khyer nas phar bskyod do/

/myur du rje btsun chen po dang mjal nas maṇ+ḍal phul te byin rlabs dang gdam ngag zhu bar gsol ba btab pas/ bka' gnang ste/ lhan cig skyes pa zab mo spros pa dang bral ba/ de kho na nyid kyi gdam ngag khyad par can gyi gdam ngag dang byin rlabs dang ngo sprod mang po gsan no/ /de nas gdams pa rnams tshar ba dang / bla ma la phyi phyag phul nas slar yang bskyod pa'i shul ka ru/ paṇ+ḍi ta kā ma la gup+ta dang mjal nas/ gdam ngag mang du gsan no/ /mkha' 'gro ma dbang du 'du ba'i khri snyan sa le'i rwa co gcig gnang ngo / /dus bzhir bus bsod nams kyi dpal thob 'ong gsung / sngar yul du gzigs pa'i rgya dpe'i bum nang nas/ mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs zab mo gcig yod pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta des mkhyen nas bslabs so/ /mkha' 'gro ma de ni sngar lung bstan byed pa de nga yin pas/ de man chad ma dang sring mo'i tshul du las byed do/ /de nas kha che'i yul du lo du lon dgongs nas brtsis pas/ lo bdun song / da pha ma gnyis dang mjal du 'gro dgos dgongs pa dang / lha bla ma'i sku drin yod pas mjal/ 'on kyang mkha' spyod du mjal bar bya gsung ba de yang thugs la dran nas/ gro kha ser po la bzhengs pa'i rgya dpe dum pa bsnams nas/ rkang mgyogs kyi gdam ngag dang slar gshegs pas skyo bang du zhag drug gi ngo la slebs pas/ yab lo gcig gi sngon la grongs nas ma 'phrad do/ /thugs la 'gyod pa drag po skyes nas/ dpal ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor khong rang gi bdun tsam mdzad do/ /yum snyung gzhi med par bzhugs nas/ sku tshe bsring ba'i ched du bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum tsam mdzad do/ /de man chod kyang lo bco brgyad du sku tshe bsring so/ /de nas lo tsā ba'i thugs dgongs la/ bdag gi mi lus rin po che thob nas bla ma mkhas pa dang mjal te/ dam pa'i chos la spyod pa su'i drin na/

lha dang yab yum gyi drin yin pas/ lha dang mjal bar dgongs nas sku gshegs pa'i gdung dang mjal/ mchi ma bton/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams zhen pa rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nas bla ma lha dang yab kyi don du/ gser srang nyi shu'i rdzas bsnams nas kha che ru gshegs te/ ra gan gyi rdzongs mdzad pas de ma thag tu gzigs te/ lha bzo ba mkhas pa bhi dha ka bya ba las/ yab kyi sku tshad mnyam pa thugs rje chen po gcig bzhengs su gsol nas/ bla ma shrād+dha ka ra bas rab tu gnas par mdzad do/ /yul nas bsnams pa'i gser srang nyi shu nas/ gser srang lnga bla ma la mnyes pa mdzad do/ /gser srang lnga la rab gnas kyi zhal gso mdzad do/ /gser srang lnga la lha bzo ba'i cha rkyen mdzad do/ /gser srang gcig bla ma la bcol te/ rten kha che'i yul du shing rta 'khor lo la 'dren par rtsom bas/ sha za lce spyang mgo can gyis/ khyod bla ma lha'i rten kyang mi bzhengs pa/ ma yengs par gdams pa rnams mi len na/ da ste zhag bdun na bar chod byed zer ro/ /khong gi thugs la/ zong srang nyi shu'i rtsis las mi 'dug phyis lan la/ bod na lugs su blugs pa la che ba gcig bzhengs bsam pa la/ mkha' 'gro'i chad pa 'ong bar shes nas/ gsol ba btab nas/ su ma ti tsan+d+ra la/ sngags rgyud rnam gsum mnyan nas/ gar yang sems ma yengs par/ byang sems bskyed nas/ rten 'khor lo la spyan drangs so/ /sngar yul nas chas man chod zla ba bcu gsum la/ slar rten dang yul du byon no/ /rten de la mthong bas yid g.yo/ mchod pa chen po byas na bar ched sel/ bsam pa'i don 'grub bo zhes jo bos gsungs so/ /khyad par du yang dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas/ de nas bla chen pos/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi zhabs tog la gser srang lnga bcu khyer nas/ slar yang kha cher yang byon no/ /yang kha che'i yul na grags pa'i sngags rgyud sde/ mdo don sdeb sbyor rnams bris pas lo bdun 'khor/ de'i bar la bla ma shrādha ka ras dbu mdzad pa'i/

paṇ+ḍi ta lnga bcu rtsa bdun la kha cher 'gyur ba'i chos ma lus par lung thob/ yi dam spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes bzung nas/ gzhan gyi klog 'don pa bas khong gi thugs la 'dzin pa myur bar byung / gro ga dang ta la la bris pa'i/ dpe pod lnga brgya bdun cu don gnyis grub/ lhag ma gser srang gsum lus 'dug pa la/ rigs gsum mgon po bzhengs nas brag seṅge'i ral pa can la bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa mdzad/ phyag rgya chen po'i grub pa thob nas/ slar tho ling du byon/ rten rigs gsum gdan 'drongs/ rgya dpe skyo bang gi brag la bzhugs su gsol/ de nas lha chen po lha lde btsan gyi bkas/ paṇ+ḍi ta pradz+nyā ka ra shrī mi tra dang / paṇ+ḍi ta su bha ṣi ta la sogs mkhas btsun mang po spyan drangs nas pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa dam chos mang du bsgyur ro/ /mdor na/ paṇ+ḍi ta bdun cu don lnga la dam chos mang du zhus gsung / lnga pa/ de nas lha lde'i dbu'i mchod gnas dang rdo rje slob dpon mdzad do/ /dgon gnas pu rangs su zher sa phul nas/ zher gyi gnas gzhi dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs su gsol lo/ /de nas kha che'i gtsug lag khang dang / rong gi gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gnas gzhi dang / gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten yang mang du bzhengs te nyi ma re re zhing chos spyod bcu rgyun mi chad pa'i thugs dam mdzad do/ /de nas lo tsā ba ༈ byang chub sems dpa' dgung lo brgyad cu gya bdun dgongs bzhes tsa na/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig pho brang btsun pas spyan drangs pa dang / pu rangs su zhal mjal nas/ khyod ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta chos mang po shes shing / lo tsā mkhas par grags pas/ nga'i lo paṇa bya dgos gsungs pas/ lo tsā bas zhus pa/ bdag na so rgas pas lo tsā mi pher/ sgra mi dag pas chos kyi sel du 'gro zhus nas/ chos bsgyur du ma bzhed pa la/ jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ nga la snying yod de/ lce med gsung nas thugs mug par byung ngo /

/der rting nag tsho lo tsā bas lo tsā byas so/ /de nas dgongs bsgrub khyad par can gang du mdzad na/ zher gyi gtsug lag khang du lo gcig khyim skor dam bca' mdzad/ sgo'i phyi rim la dung gi yi ge gcig bris nas/ bdag la sang phod ding sang gi bar du/ nyon mongs pa'i yid skad cig ma gcig skyes na/ mkha' 'gro mas chad pa chod gcig ces bris so/ /de'i nang gi rim pa la/ dngul gyi yi ge gcig la/ bdag la sang phod ding gi bar du/ byang chub kyi sems skad cig ma dang bral na/ mkha' 'gro mas chad pa chod cig ces so/ /lha khang gi nang ngos su gser gyi yi ge la/ bdag la sang phod deng sang gi bar la/ lung ma bstan gyi sems skad cig ma gcig rgyud la skyes na mkha' 'gro mas chad pa chod cig ces rgya rim pa gsum la dam bca' bris nas/ thugs dam mdzad pas/ dam bca' tshad du phyin nas/ chos sku spros bral rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes so/ /de la sogs pa gnas khyad par can rnams su bsgrub pa mang dag tu mdzad/ tha ma mkha' spyod kyi gnas su gang nas gshegs na/ la las 'om le'i chu mig lta rdzi grub rdo'i kha nas/ phung po lhag med du bskyod zer te/ de ru lo gcig bsgrub pa mdzad pa las sa de nas gshegs pa ma yin no/ /kha che ri wing go ru lug gi lo dgu bcu go brgyad lon tsa na/ dgun zla tha chung gi dgung tshes bcu bdun/ skar ma rta pa la gzhan don la spyod do/ /de nas ka bzhi gdung brgyad la sogs pa'i bu slob rnams kyis gdung sbyangs pas/ sku gdung gi dngos po yungs kar gyi shun pa tsam yang ma byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi mthun 'jug tu/ ring bsrel shing thog 'o ma se ltar du shin tu dmar ba gsum zhig byung ste/ nam mkha' nas rol sgra sna tshogs 'brug ltar grags te/ mkha' spyod du gshegs te/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam du/ yul gyi lha 'dre chos la dga' ba dang / dam la btags pa/ 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre rnams mtshan mo res kyi gdung mchod kyi sa ru ngu chom gyi 'debs pa mang du byung ngo /

/de nas zhag gcig skar ma rta pa dang nya'i dgung tshes bco lnga la/ gdung spur sa ru/ 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi char mang du babs nas/ de man chad lha 'dre mya ngan byed pa'i sgra yang chad do/ /rgyu mtshan de jo bo chen po rje lha gcig la zhus pas/ lo tsā ba byang chub sems dpa'/ lha 'dre rnams la snying rje bar dgongs nas lha srin rnams la nam mkha'i dbyings nas/ mi rtag pa'i chos gsung du byon nas/ 'dre srin rnams chos la bkod do/ /de man chad mya ngan sangs pa yin gsung / dus ding sang khong ni nub phyogs bde ba can du mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi go chas spyan drangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi spyan lam du bzhugs te mchis/ gsung gin thal mo sbyar ba mdzad do/ /yang khyim bdag sbas pas zhus pa na/ zhang zhung gi sa'i cha/ kha che ru dge slong bya'i gdong pa can/ dam bca' rnam bzhi rgyud thog tu longs pa skye bar 'gyur/ de'i rjes su zhugs pas thar pa'i lam thob par 'gyur zhes lung bstan to/ /lo tsā ba skyes mchog rin chen bzang po'i skye brgyud dka' bcad sgron ma kha'i dang / dz+nyā na shrīs yi ge ris su bris pa rdzogs so// //khong rang gi yul kha che ru/ skyes mchog gi gdung nye shos/ dbon po bsod nams dpal bzang po la legs pa zhus nas zam kha ba bdag gis bris pa lags so// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 sgrol ma kha'i dang / dz+nyā na shrī/ skyes mchog rin chen bzang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
